subject: RFP - Enterprise Document Management System
body:
Dear Team,

Meridian Steel invites proposals for an enterprise DMS covering 4 plants and ~1,200 users. Indicative budget is Rs. 25 lakhs. Proposals must reach us by 12th August 2026.

Regards,
Suresh
